CustomField.description: Alerts the user to populate the vended / unvended textfield if Opportunity has at least one product where Product Class is equal to records management
CustomField.formula:
IF(
IME_Num_of_Storage_Boxes__c > 0,
IF( IME_Number_of_Record_Management_Products__c = 0, "", IF( AND( IME_Number_of_Record_Management_Products__c > 0, ISPICKVAL( IME_Vended_Unvended__c , "") ), IMAGE("/img/msg_icons/error16.png" , "Error")& " " & $Label.IME_Vended_ErrorMessage, IMAGE("/img/msg_icons/confirm16.png", "Success")& " " ) ),
""
)
CustomField.label: Vended/Unvended Alert
